prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction. Edit target: the supplied cream and gold wedding flat-lay reference. Extract and recreate ONLY its champagne kraft wedding envelope with the antique gold wax seal embossed with two interlocked hearts. Deliver one isolated complete envelope as a separate web compositing asset on true transparent alpha. Photorealistic macro stationery photography, overhead orthographic view with no perspective skew, long landscape envelope ratio about 1.5:1. Envelope unrotated, edges horizontal and vertical. Real warm beige cotton kraft fibers, envelope fold seams and closed triangular flap with subtle natural shadows, uneven metallic wax seal placed toward the LEFT quarter around mid-height so it remains visible when a tall invitation card overlaps the right half. Soft daylight from upper left. Tight clean crop with only 3 percent transparent margin. Preserve the natural premium material and muted ivory/champagne/antique gold palette of the reference. No card, no photos, no flowers, no ribbon, no background surface, no typography, no watermark, no CSS-looking gradients, no black background. This is ONLY the single envelope component.

Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction. Edit target: supplied cream and gold wedding flat-lay reference. Extract and recreate ONLY the tall central ivory invitation CARD as an independent transparent-background website asset. Preserve its realistic thick cotton paper texture and delicate warm off-white color, subtle gently irregular cut edges, natural soft shadow and rounded corners. Overhead orthographic flat lay, unrotated upright portrait card, about 0.60 width to 1 height, full card visible and close crop with 2 percent transparent margin. REMOVE ALL LETTERING, names, dates, SAVE THE DATE and all text so those can be typeset in HTML. Keep the upper 60 percent completely blank usable ivory paper. Retain a photorealistic thin natural flax twine wrapped horizontally across the card at 65 percent of its height, a small delicate bow near the center with a dangling small antique gold heart charm and a tiny ivory tag with a gold airplane pictogram. At bottom 25 percent retain a very faint pale beige world-map imprint but NO letters, NO date, NO dashed flight route. Real fibers and real twine, gentle daylight upper-left. No envelope, flowers, photos, ribbon, other background objects, hands, text, watermark. Genuine transparent alpha outside the card. This is one separate card component, not a whole scene.

Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction. Edit target: supplied cream and gold wedding flat-lay reference. Extract and recreate ONLY one graceful botanical arrangement from the LEFT side: lifelike ivory white roses, a few small white five-petal blossoms and airy baby's breath, slim natural olive green leaves, with one loose champagne beige silk ribbon flowing softly between stems. This must be an independent compositing component on genuine transparent alpha, NOT a whole wedding scene. Tall asymmetrical botanical spray, blossoms concentrated in LOWER LEFT half, airy delicate stems and smaller buds extending upward and toward right. About 0.7 width to 1 height. Photorealistic overhead macro photography, natural detailed petals with slight imperfections, soft studio daylight from upper left, premium elegant cream/champagne/olive palette. Full uncropped leaves and ribbon tails within image, tight margins, natural soft contact shadow only around arrangement. Absolutely no stationery, cards, envelope, seal, people, typography, surface, frame, checkerboard or opaque background. Match the reference's realistic wedding styling.

Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction. Edit target: supplied wedding stationery flat-lay reference. Extract and recreate ONLY the antique champagne-gold BOARDING PASS ticket behind the central ivory card. Deliver ONE independent isolated horizontal rectangular gold paper ticket, unrotated overhead orthographic view, width about 2.5 times height, fully visible with gently rounded corners, real fine cotton paper texture and understated antique gold metallic surface, softly lit from upper left. Blank front surface with NO words, NO letters, NO plane, NO icons: HTML text will be added separately. Tight crop with 2 percent transparent margin. True transparent alpha around the complete card and its very subtle natural contact shadow. Preserve the muted warm-gold paper look of the reference, avoid orange or shiny plastic. No envelope, invitation card, twine, flowers, photos, surface, frames, watermark or other objects. This is ONLY the single blank ticket component.
